name: Claude session (shared session parts for the Terminal and the companion)
description: The pure parts of a Claude session that more than one app shows: live meters (status, model name, money), the CLAUDE.md / rules context chain and its reveal pacing (harvested from the console Terminal's headless tabs), and what a companion chat adds on top of assistant@1: the companion's name (Gizmo), conversation ordering, search and day groups, the model-policy pick list (Opus, Fable; Sonnet and Haiku coerced up), budget caps, speakable text, sentence chunks for spoken replies, interrupt words and tool cards. No UI, no network, no dependencies. Built Nov 3 2026 (Opus), build gizmo-companion.
